commit.message:
LU-20169 tests: stress stats read during module unload

Add conf-sanity.sh test_180 to stress test stats reading during module
unload and reload.  This is a frequent source of problems when system
monitoring tools are actively accessing stats during mount/unmount.
Configure a nodemap to include those parameters into the testing.
